### In the Beginning
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/beginning
Passage: Genesis 1:1–2
Points:
- Genesis establishes who God is before unfolding His redemptive covenant history.
- The declaration that God created everything reveals His eternal existence and total sovereignty.
- Scripture refutes pantheism by demonstrating that God transcends and exists independently of creation.
- God brought forth the universe effortlessly through His spoken word rather than conflict.
- Recognizing the self-existent Lord should draw us into humble, heartfelt worship.

### Behold God’s Beautiful Creation
Author: In Touch Ministries
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/behold-god-s-beautiful-creation
Passage: Genesis 1:1-31
Points:
- God crafted every element of the cosmos with precision, design, and intention.
- The splendor and diversity of the natural world reveal the Lord's wisdom and artistry.
- Pausing from daily busyness to observe nature inspires genuine gratitude and wonder.
- God's pronouncement that creation is very good affirms our inherent worth in His eyes.
- Every aspect of creation serves as a reminder of our Maker's unending love.

### God’s Omnipotence in Creation
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-september-4.html
Passage: Genesis 1:1
Points:
- The universe was called into being out of nothing by divine command.
- The intricate order across all matter reveals an intentional, almighty Designer.
- Material reality cannot be accounted for by mere chance or naturalistic processes.
- God is the author and sustainer of every human breath.
- Recognizing His creative power leads to gratitude for our gift of life.

### Our Creator
Author: Carolyn Dale Newell
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/our-creator-encouragement-caf-jan-12-2015.html
Passage: Genesis 1:1
Points:
- The title Elohim reveals God specifically as the sovereign Creator of all things.
- The rich variety throughout nature highlights the Lord's thoughtful care in design.
- The universe is fine-tuned to sustain human life on earth.
- The God powerful enough to make heaven and earth can easily handle our daily trials.
- Contemplating creation gives believers comfort and trust in His divine plan.
